problem_statement: Multiple unrelated endpoints (POST /v1/auth/register, POST /v1/auth/login, GET /v1/users, GET /v1/users/:id) all return 500. Creating and reading users both fail.
gold_patch: Correct `.toStrng()` to `.toString()` at src/models/plugins/toJSON.plugin.js:31 (revert of bug_patch).

runtime_workload.cmd: register/login/getUser probes against the instrumented app

runtime_dependence: The cause is in source (a typo in the shared serializer) but NON-LOCAL: the symptom is 'register AND login AND getUser all 500', a fan-in a reader must discover by finding the common denominator across many routes. NEAT's incident stack trace collapses the multi-route symptom to toJSON.plugin.js:31 immediately. Runtime-rooted — NEAT wins on search cost, not on possibility.

root_cause.detail: Method typo `.toStrng()` in the shared serializer applied to every model, so every response that serializes a document throws.
